semantics.abstain: nothing is touched: the episode is the uninterrupted one (checked against the trunk in every scene, for every arm)
semantics.noise: repeat 0 only; every inference is keyed by seed_for(scene, physical step, 0, 'dp')
semantics.restore: reset(seed) + prefix action replay; the restored runtime is compared with the snapshot before every arm
semantics.memories: built in the trunk from the policy's own observation; they never touch the policy, its queue or its observation history; the mirrored memory must equal the original v2 memory at every trigger

analysis.unit: scene, within policy; the 200 scenes are shared by the two policies and are never counted as 400 independent observations
analysis.outcome: success_once_absorbing, all 200 scenes in every denominator

primary.H_gen: train seed 2: VISION_CENTER_V2 above C0; exact conditional paired test on the discordant scenes, one-sided
primary.H_mem: VISION_CENTER_V2 above V2_SINGLE_FRAME with both policies; one exact conditional paired test per policy, combined by intersection-union (the larger of the two p-values)

descriptive: per policy: success of every arm with its Wilson interval
per policy: every arm against C0 (rescue, harm, net)
per policy: v2 against v1, v2 against each leave-one-out arm, V2_RULES_OFF against v2, v2s against v2, oracle against v2
per policy: decisions by reason, moves by source, memory errors, unnecessary moves, target pushed, oracle rescues recovered
between policies: v2 net gain per policy, their difference on the same scenes with a scene bootstrap, as a range

safety_per_policy.meaning: development criteria for going on; they do not replace a calibration and certify no harm rate
safety_per_policy.on_failure: reported as not met; no re-run, no tuning

not_claimed: the effect of any single v2 rule (V2_RULES_OFF removes a bundle)

offline_replay.what: offline decision replay on the 500 used scenes 50600-51099 (development data). Decisions only: no rollout, no outcome, no rescue or harm of any replayed arm.

wrong_by_label.definition: target error over 5 mm, or over the target part of its own bound

control_replay_along_v2_frames.note: v2s is replayed on the frames v2 produced; valid up to the first step where v2s would stop, because until then both send the same command

does: every arm with every technical check of the run, with both policies
seconds per environment step, per vision reading and per memory step for the budget gate

run.ledger: artifacts/ledger/vision_center_c1.json, created exclusively before any rollout on a new scene; one ledger for both passes; no resume, no second pass
run.on_error: the run stops and stays INCOMPLETE; no scene is dropped or replaced; a partial run has no summary
run.stored: one record per scene and policy, per-step ground-truth traces (logging), both cameras' frames of every step up to the trigger, the frames of every vision arm at the trigger and during control
run.thread_limit: OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS, BLIS_NUM_THREADS = 1 before every Python process (run.sh exports them)

cost_estimate.status: ESTIMATE; nothing was run. The budget gate on the server uses measured times, not these numbers

basis.host: Phase B: RTX 4090, AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, US$0.4604/h, thread limit 1
basis.memory_step_note: each trunk step updates the original v2 memory with its own fits and all other memories from one shared set of fits; the factor is an assumption until the audit measures it

cost_estimate.storage_note: frames of both cameras up to the trigger for 400 scene runs and the control frames of the vision arms; the download adds the per-GB transfer price
cost_estimate.gate_rule: the budget step projects the whole run from the times measured in the audit with every scene at its bound, margin 1.25, reserve US$0.30, and refuses above the approved cap; spend so far is computed from the session clock; before every scene the run stops INCOMPLETE if one more scene at its bound could pass the cap. Scenes, arms and bounds are never reduced

technical_stop_conditions: no authorization, or one that names another plan
a code file, a policy file, the seed registry or the arm registry differs from this plan
tests fail on the server; CUDA or Vulkan check fails (the host is discarded before any scene)
an identical initial placement for a new seed
the restored runtime differs from the snapshot; C0 or an abstaining arm does not reproduce the trunk
ground truth reaches a vision arm (oracle read counter)
the mirrored memory differs from hci.vision_center_v2.Memory at a trigger
policy inference during a control part, or a queue left at the hand-back
the budget projection exceeds the cap before the run, after five scenes of a pass, or before any scene
